regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with clear spells at first. Cloud will build from the southwest through the night. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with patches of mist and fog forming in light variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will see cloud increase through the day, bringing a chance of light rain and drizzle at times in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in mostly light easterly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Sunday and Monday.
